ideas.title: Businesses without a website — lead feed for web agencies
ideas.why: Owner's outreach idea reshaped into data; Apify already sells scraped versions at US$1–5/1k rows.

ideas.title: Marketplace where people request digital services on top of the APIs
ideas.why: Two-sided cold start with no marketing budget and human ops (vetting, disputes, payouts); does not use the data edge yet.
ideas.trigger: ≈1,000 monthly API/stats users, or the no-website lead feed selling to agencies who ask for fulfilment

ideas.title: Contact businesses lacking a website by email / AI phone and sell them sites
ideas.why: Automated calls need prior consent under PECR; cold email to sole traders needs consent; delivery is per-customer human work.

ideas.title: Use portfolio revenue to fund algorithmic trading
ideas.why: Owner's stated end goal; fees exceed edge at £100 capital, so it waits for banked revenue.
ideas.trigger: £1,000 of banked net revenue and a written risk plan reviewed by the owner

ideas.title: Form a UK limited company to unlock Datarade / AWS Data Exchange listings
ideas.why: Both marketplaces refuse sole traders; formation ≈ £50 plus annual filing burden on the owner.

ideas.title: UK Trade Marks Journal — weekly accepted applications as a dataset + change feed (trade-mark watch)
ideas.why: Watch services charge £180–320/mark/yr to scan this weekly OGL XML; Apify sells per-search scrapes at $0.05/record; nobody serves the journal as a queryable feed with opposition deadlines. Exchange 2026-W39 winner, score 8.

ideas.title: Gambling Commission operator register (operators, premises, regulatory actions)
ideas.why: 2,642 operators, daily CSV; two Apify actors price it from $8/1k rows; KYB/payments buyers. Half-day build; OGL statement to confirm on the data.gov.uk record before publishing. Exchange 2026-W39 runner-up, score 6.

ideas.title: Variables Toolkit v0.2: relink local/broken variables to library variables by name
ideas.why: Clearest unmet ask in rival comments (Variable Utilities $17×181, Design System Organizer); scores 7.2 but each release costs an owner publish + Figma re-review and the day-7 read is not in yet.
ideas.trigger: day-7 review (2026-09-28) shows ≥ 100 installs, or any listing comment asks for library/relink behaviour

ideas.title: Second Figma plugin: variables diff / compare across files
ideas.why: Sub-niche with no paid plugin in the 2026-09-17 census, but no growth evidence and no sales data from our first listing yet.
ideas.trigger: Variables Toolkit day-30 (2026-10-21) shows ≥ 1 purchase or ≥ 500 installs

ideas.title: Shopify App Store app
ideas.why: Partner registration $19 exceeds the £10 launch cap, the Partner account carries the owner identity, and merchants expect per-install support (human hours per sale).

ideas.title: Stripe App Marketplace app
ideas.why: One app per activated account with the owner name/email on the listing, review needs a test plan and credentials, and no portfolio product fits the surface.

ideas.title: Third browser extension
ideas.why: STRATEGY §8 2026-09-20: no more consumer apps until one sells; ReadFocus and Highlight Keep are days from their first store data.

ideas.title: FCA Financial Services Register dataset
ideas.why: Register API terms forbid sharing or re-selling the data; bulk access is the paid Register Extract Service. Standalone product would breach the licence (same category as CCOD/OCOD).

ideas.title: Japan corporate register (gBizINFO) dataset + Apify actor
ideas.why: Owner asked 2026-09-24 whether a larger market (Asia) would help. ~4M corporations, government-run, permissive terms, JSON API with a free key (no local identity needed); same KYB/sales-intelligence buyers as the UK line, reachable on the same global shelves. Not first: the current bottleneck is distribution, not market size.
ideas.trigger: two shelves open (Apify actors public, stats pages indexed) and gankdat still < 3 real signups 30 days later

ideas.title: Singapore ACRA entities + GeBIZ tenders (data.gov.sg)
ideas.why: Singapore Open Data Licence permits commercial use; English-language; pairs with uk-tenders/eu-ted as an APAC procurement feed. Same caveat as Japan: supply is not the constraint today.
ideas.trigger: same as japan-gbizinfo-register; pick whichever the exchange scores higher on paid-rival evidence

ideas.title: Port the ARE (Asset Retrieval Engine) product into Foundry
ideas.why: Owner asked 2026-09-28. Declined: internal BD tool with a drug-licensing revenue model, mandatory clinician review, Postgres+OpenSearch+Redis+Celery server stack, no external buyer or price in its docs — breaks the no-human-hours, no-recurring-cost and shelf-with-buyers rules. See ventures/gankdat/docs/ARE-REUSE-NOTES.md.

ideas.title: Pharma regulatory registers on gankdat: FDA shortages, Orange Book, Drugs@FDA, EMA, MHRA (from ARE's verified source inventory)
ideas.why: Free, public-domain/OGL/attribution-licensed registers whose URLs, formats and quirks ARE already documented (ventures/gankdat/docs/ARE-REUSE-NOTES.md). Buyers: generics/505(b)(2) planners, pharmacy procurement, market access; paid rivals Citeline, GlobalData, DrugPatentWatch, ASHP. Same DataSource shape as our UK registers; change feeds are the product. Exchange 2026-W40 scored it 3.0 (evidence 3 × reach 2 ÷ 2 days): openFDA serves the registers free, S&P Global and one Apify actor sell them, buyers are US generics/BD teams outside the shelves we reach. Supply, not shelf.
ideas.trigger: a shelf converts (≥ 1 paying account or ≥ 20 paid Apify runs/month) and the Apify run data shows demand for non-UK registers

ideas.title: Region-delta feed: drugs authorised in the EU/UK but absent from Drugs@FDA (and the reverse), daily diff
ideas.why: ARE's core insight, nobody sells it as a feed; derived from the pharma-registers line via an INN join (RxNorm). Distinctive enough to earn backlinks and pharma-BD searches.
ideas.trigger: pharma-registers-line shipped and queried by at least one external key

ideas.title: List gankdat's MCP server in the Claude Connectors Directory (then lazy OAuth so plans bill from Claude)
ideas.why: Exchange 2026-W40 winner, score 11 (evidence 3 × reach 4 ÷ 0.75 days + 20 owner min). A shelf with the agents' owners as buyers that lists automatically after a policy scan on the owner's paid Claude plan — no third-party gate. Server needs tool annotations, Origin 403, a keyless preview so every tool answers, and a listing pack; OAuth (CIMD + PKCE) queued second so paid plans work inside Claude and the same server becomes submittable to ChatGPT/Cursor.

ideas.title: Apify Store quality-score / README keyword pass over the 17 public actors
ideas.why: Store search and the Apify MCP search-actors tool weight name, short description, README, categories, then runs and ratings. publish-actors.mjs already sets seoTitle/seoDescription/categories; the copy lever is spent and the rest is the run flywheel, so nothing to change blind (W40 raw score 16, discounted).
ideas.trigger: the first 14 days of metrics-apify-runs show ≥ 10 actors with 0 runs; then a keyword pass against store-search data read through the relay

ideas.title: n8n verified community node for gankdat (npm publish with provenance via GitHub Actions)
ideas.why: A shelf inside n8n Cloud; verification needs provenance publishing (workflow installer can), no runtime deps, one service per package, and an npm token from the owner. Evidence 2, reach 3, 1 day + 10 min → 5.1, below the 7 baseline (W40).
ideas.trigger: the Claude directory listing shows ≥ 20 distinct accounts using a tool in 30 days

ideas.title: Snowflake Marketplace data listing for the gankdat registers
ideas.why: Needs a full Snowflake account, a signed provider agreement and paid-listing profile, and products billed by consumer consumption; sole-trader eligibility unstated and compute is a recurring-cost risk under the £10/month rule (W40, score 3).
ideas.trigger: data line passes £300 MRR (same as limited-company)

ideas.title: ChatGPT App Directory app on the gankdat MCP server (Apps SDK)
ideas.why: Largest reach of any candidate and the Apps SDK is MCP, but submission requires OpenAI business verification with tax documents (KYC beyond a one-off account) and the directory does not bill for us. Declined on constraint (W40); re-raise only if the owner opts into that verification after mcp-oauth-lazy-auth ships.
